offering_description.value: F&G issues annuities and life insurance for individuals, mainly through insurance agents and financial institutions. It also takes on employer pension obligations through group annuity contracts and issues funding agreements for institutional investors.

primary_products.value: fixed indexed annuities; fixed-rate annuities; indexed universal life insurance; group pension annuities; funding agreements

primary_services.value: pension risk transfer and administration of assumed pension benefits

customer_segment.value: B2C: retirement savers and individual life insurance buyers; B2B: employers with defined benefit pension plans and institutional fixed-income investors

end_markets.value: retirement savings and income; individual life insurance; employer defined benefit pensions; institutional fixed income

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: annuity and life insurance premiums, investment spreads on assets backing annuities and funding agreements

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: invests premiums and deposits to support insurance, annuity and funding obligations to individuals and institutions; service provider: assumes employer pension obligations and pays benefits to covered retirees and beneficiaries

geography_served.value: US national: United States, including New York through a separate insurance subsidiary

specialization.value: related lines: individual annuities, indexed life insurance, group pension annuities and institutional funding agreements

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: independent insurance agents and insurance marketing organizations; partners / resellers: banks, broker-dealers and financial advisory firms; direct sales: institutional teams working with pension sponsors and funding counterparties
distribution_channels.category: agents / brokers; partners / resellers; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: high: state insurance departments oversee insurer licensing, solvency and policy forms
